summary: Testing CxP search fix (Bug P1). Code review confirms the fix is CORRECT. However, CANNOT fully test in browser due to pre-existing authentication issue (403 Forbidden on all API calls). The frontend is not sending the auth cookie/token in requests after login.

integration_issues.issue: After login, API requests show 'NO AUTH HEADER' and return 403 Forbidden. The cookie edarsa_access_token is set by server but not sent by browser in subsequent requests.
integration_issues.details: This is a pre-existing issue blocking all API calls. The CxP search fix cannot be tested in browser because cxpData is empty (no data loaded).
integration_issues.root_cause: SameSite=lax + Secure cookie not being sent in cross-origin requests from Preview environment. memoryToken fallback also not working.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix authentication issue - cookies/tokens not being sent in API requests after login
The CxP search fix code is CORRECT but cannot be validated in browser due to auth issue
Backend API works correctly when tested with curl + Bearer token
critical_code_review_comments: CxP Search Fix (FinanzasCuentasPorPagar.jsx lines 113-187) is CORRECT:
- proveedoresExtraidos: Correctly extracts unique providers from cxpData.proveedores (nested A/B/X structure)
- proveedoresFiltrados: Correctly normalizes search text (lowercase, no accents) and searches in multiple fields
- Fallback to cxpProveedores endpoint if no results in extracted data
- Dropdown correctly displays results with category badge
Backend API /api/finanzas/cuentas-por-pagar returns correct data structure with proveedores containing facturas with proveedor_nombre field
context_for_next_testing_agent: CxP search fix code is correct but cannot be tested in browser due to authentication issue. After login, the auth cookie/token is not being sent in subsequent API requests (all return 403 Forbidden). Backend API works correctly when tested with curl + Bearer token. The fix extracts providers from cxpData.proveedores (nested structure) instead of relying on separate cxpProveedores endpoint.

logic.proveedoresExtraidos: Extracts unique providers from cxpData.proveedores by iterating categories (A/B/X) and their facturas
logic.proveedoresFiltrados: Normalizes search text and searches in proveedor_nombre, proveedor_rfc, proveedor_clave, proveedor_id
logic.fallback: If no results in extracted data, falls back to cxpProveedores from endpoint

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Authentication cookies not being sent in browser requests after login. Server sets HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=lax cookie but browser doesn't send it in subsequent requests. memoryToken fallback in api.js also not working.
reproduction_steps: 2. Navigate to Finanzas > Cuentas por Pagar
4. Observe all API requests have 'NO AUTH HEADER' and return 403 Forbidden
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Fix authentication flow to ensure token is sent in requests. Check if memoryToken is being set correctly in AuthContext after login.
